paite: Dawnna nem in thangpaihna aheimang a; himahleh thusia in hehna atokthou hi.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

paite: Mipil lei in theihna agen dik a; himahleh mihaite kam in haina asungkhia hi.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

paite: TOUPA mitte mun chiteng ah a-om a, hoih lou leh hoih veng gige in.
english: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

paite: Lei damthei hinna sing ahi; himahleh huai a kilawmlouhna kha sukkhapna ahi.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

paite: Mihai in apa bawlhoihna amusit a; himahleh kuapeuh salhna limsak in pilvanna amu hi.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

paite: Midiktat inn ah gou tampi a-om; himahleh migilou summuhna buaina ahi.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

paite: Mipil mukte'n theihna aphalh a; himahleh mihai lungtang in huchibang in ahih kei hi.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

paite: Migilou kithoihna TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh mitang thumna akipahna ahi.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

paite: Migilou lampi TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh diktatna zui a-it hi.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

paite: Lampi mangngilhmi a ding in bawlhoihna haksatak a-om a; huan kuapeuh taihilhna mudah asi ding hi.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

paite: Sheol leh Abaddon TOUPA ma ah a-om uh; mite tate lungtangte bangzah phet in atamzaw diam aw?
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

paite: Musitmi'n salh a om nuam asa kei; mipil kiang azuan kei ding hi.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

paite: Lungtang nuam in mel kipak abawl a; himahleh lungtang dahna ziak in lungsim apuakkham hi.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

paite: Theihsiamna nei lungtang in theihna azong; himahleh mihaite kam haina in akivak hi.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

paite: Gimthuak nite tengteng hoih lou ahi; himahleh kuapeuh lungtang kipak in ankuangluina anei gige hi.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

paite: TOUPA launa toh tawmchik ahoihzaw, huai agou thupi leh buaina sang in.
english: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

paite: Itna omna a anteh-louhing nek ding ahoihzaw, bawngtal thau leh huai a muhdahna sang in.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

paite: Mithangpai in kinialna atokthou a; himahleh kuapeuh heh hak in kinakna adamsak hi.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

paite: Thadah lampi ling daikalh bang ahi; himahleh mitang lampi lamlian abawl ahi.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

paite: Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh mihai in anu amusit hi.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

paite: Pilna bei a ding in haina nopsakna ahi; himahleh theisiammi in apaina atangsak hi.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

paite: Thupha omlouhna ah, thiltupte avuaksuak; himahleh thupha gen tamna ah hihkip in a-om uh.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

paite: Akam a dawnna ah mi'n nopsakna anei; huan ahuntak a thugen hoih hi na mah e.
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

paite: Mipil a ding in hinna lampi apaitou a, nuailam a Sheol a kipan apaimang theihna ding in.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

paite: TOUPA'N kisathei inn azungkalhkhiak ding; himahleh meithai gamgi ahihkip ding.
english: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

paite: TOUPA a ding in lunggel giloute akihhuai a; himahleh lungsim siangthoute thugen ama kipah lam ahi.
english: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

paite: Punna a duhgawl in ama inn ahihbuai a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak hua ahing ding.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

paite: Midiktat lungtang in dawng ding in akisin a; himahleh migilou kam in thil hoih lou asungkhia hi.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

paite: Migilou a kipan gamla ah TOUPA a-om a; himahleh midiktat thumna aza hi.
english: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

paite: Mitte vakna in lungtang akipaksak a; huan tanchinhoih in guhte athausak hi.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

paite: Hinna taihilhnate ngaikhia bil mipilte lak ah a-om gige ding.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

paite: Kuapeuh bawlhoihna nial in amah kha amusit ahi; himahleh kuapeuh taihilhna ngaikhia in theihsiamna amu hi.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

paite: TOUPA kihtak pilna thuhilhna ahi; huan zahtakna ma ah kiniamkhiakna apai hi.
english: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
